label: nyiso 10 import-node-zones
definition: KEEPER. U9 on top of U8 (priced interchange, nyiso 9): remaps NYISO's IMPORT_NODE_LINKS to the zones each intertie PHYSICALLY enters, measured from NYISO's hourly ExternalLimitsFlows postings, instead of the stock placement that landed imports in Capital_Hudson/Lower_Hudson (no net-import tie there). Now imports land in Upstate_West (HQ Chateauguay zone D + IESO/Ontario + PJM AC ties), NYC (PJM HTP + Linden VFT), and Long Island (PJM Neptune + ISO-NE Cross-Sound + NPX_1385); Capital_Hudson/Lower_Hudson are served across Central-East from upstate, so cheap imports can no longer bypass the interface. Restores BOTH the upstate level and the west->east spread across all years: Upstate $28.7/$35.1/$53.2 (actual 25.3/33.1/55.5); spread Cap-Up +11.4/+4.6/+4.9 (actual +9.3/+3.7/+7.9); MAE 4.81/2.03/6.77 (vs nyiso-8 10.98/2.34/3.18 and nyiso-9 3.45/1.28/7.37). Remaining residual = 2025 downstate LEVEL too low (NYC -9, LI -12): the in-city must-run / downstate-pocket structure is the next root cause, NOT the interchange.
